Linjer Generates 19X+ ROI with WhatsApp Marketing & Chatbots

AllModern Uses AI WhatsApp Journeys To Recover Carts With 22%+ Conversion
All Modern uses BiteSpeed’s AI WhatsApp journeys to engage shoppers in real time and recover high-intent drop-offs. With 80%+ open rates and 22% conversion, cart recovery now runs fully on autopilot without any manual effort.
